backend/main.mo: Motoko canister defining types and state for user profiles, tool listings, rentals, chat, and authorization, with functions for profile management and sorted listing comparisons.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping UI/UX polish, shared utilities, and cleanup tasks to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing brief descriptions of many frontend pages, components, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and base styling for the app.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main routing configuration using TanStack Router with theme provider and page routes including community map.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading state and error handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Wrapper component that shows a login prompt card when the user is not authenticated.
frontend/src/components/community/Commun: Interactive world map displaying member profiles with pan/zoom, marker clicks, and selection highlighting.
frontend/src/components/landing/Toolshed: Section component with themed background, label, header, and content for landing page storytelling.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: Simple footer showing copyright, branding, and link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Responsive header with navigation, authentication-aware links, and mobile menu drawer.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Layout wrapper adding header, footer, and main content container.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageHeade: Page header with title, optional subtitle, and optional action buttons.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageShell: Container wrapper providing consistent page padding and layout.
frontend/src/components/listings/BrowseF: Filter bar providing search, category, sorting, price range, and availability controls for tool listings.
frontend/src/components/listings/CameraC: Camera interface for capturing photos, handling permissions, errors, and device support.
frontend/src/components/listings/Listing: Grid view rendering tool listings with images, category badges, availability state, and detail links.
frontend/src/components/listings/OwnerAc: Shows owner-only actions for a tool listing, allowing navigation to edit and toggling availability via mutation.
frontend/src/components/listings/PhotoRe: Manages adding, displaying, and removing photo URLs or camera captures for a listing.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Active: Displays details and chat panel for a selected rental conversation, including tool info and participant profile.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Conver: Lists rental conversations with tool and user info, allowing selection to open a conversation.
frontend/src/components/navigation/AppNa: Wraps a router link with active/inactive styling for navigation.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Shows a user avatar menu with profile info, navigation to profile, and logout handling.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Prompts new users to enter profile details and saves them via mutation.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalCh: Renders rental chat messages with sending capability and auto-scrolling, supporting two display variants.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalRe: Form component for submitting rental requests with date validation and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalSt: Renders owner/renter action buttons for updating rental status with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/states/EmptyStat: Generic UI card showing an icon, title, description, and optional action for empty states.
frontend/src/components/states/ErrorStat: Displays an error-themed card with icon, message, and optional action section.
frontend/src/components/states/LoadingSt: Centered loading spinner component with optional message and styling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refetching queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing identity loading and login state.
frontend/src/hooks/useMapTransform.ts: Hook implementing zooming, panning, dragging, and pinch-zoom behavior for map-like UIs.
frontend/src/hooks/useMapZoom.ts: Simplified hook providing zoom state and wheel-based zoom controls without panning.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, tools, listings, and community map data via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and CSS variables defining light and dark theme palettes plus global typography and layout rules.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app root and wraps it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/BrowseListingsPage.ts: Browse listings page with search filters that fetch and display tool listings using useSearchTools.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityMapPage.tsx: Community map page showing member profiles on a map and in a directory, with authentication checks and loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page with hero section, decorative elements, navigation actions, and authentication‑aware CTAs.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information about a tool listing, including owner actions, availability, photos, and rental request workflow.
frontend/src/pages/ListingFormPage.tsx: Form page for creating or editing a tool listing, loading existing data in edit mode and submitting through query hooks with validation.
frontend/src/pages/MessagingPage.tsx: Displays user conversations tied to rentals, showing either an empty state or a split view of conversations and the active chat.
frontend/src/pages/MyRentalsPage.tsx: Shows the current user's rental requests and bookings with status, linked tool details, and actions, or an empty state if none exist.
frontend/src/pages/MyToolsPage.tsx: Lists the user's owned tool listings with alerts for pending or active rental requests and provides navigation for adding tools.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Allows viewing and editing of the authenticated user's profile, saving updates via mutation and handling edit mode via URL params.
frontend/src/pages/RentalDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information about a specific rental, including tool data, cost breakdown, status actions, and messaging panel.
frontend/src/pages/RequestsPage.tsx: Renders the incoming rental requests page, listing rentals for the user's tools with status, dates, and action controls.
frontend/src/utils/fileToDataUrl.ts: Converts a File object to a data URL using FileReader and returns it as a Promise.
frontend/src/utils/geoProjection.ts: Provides coordinate validation, parsing, and conversion from geographic coordinates to screen percentage positions via equirectangular projection.
frontend/src/utils/rentals/rentalDateFor: Formats bigint timestamps into various date strings and calculates rental duration in days.
frontend/src/utils/rentals/rentalStatusP: Defines mappings and helpers for rental status labels and Tailwind color classes.
frontend/src/utils/timeOnApp.ts: Formats a user's join timestamp into human-readable durations and long-form join dates.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL parameters with sessionStorage support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, radii, shadows, animations, and enabling plugins.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature requirements, and notes about ongoing UI/UX and code refactor efforts.
